params.name: database
params.description: KEGG database to search. Supported: genes, ligand, compound, glycan, reaction, rclass, enzyme, disease, drug, dgroup, environ, network, variant, ko, genome, pathway, brite, module.

items.docs: Search entries in a KEGG database by keyword or query data. Returns tab-delimited text with matching entry identifiers and names. Searchable fields vary by database and may include ENTRY, NAME, SYMBOL, COMPOSITION, and DEFINITION.

info.name: Search compound or drug entries by molecular property

params.name: database
params.description: Database to search — compound or drug

params.name: query
params.description: Molecular formula (e.g., C6H12O6), exact mass range (e.g., 174.05-174.15), or molecular weight range (e.g., 180-180)

items.docs: Search compound or drug database entries by molecular formula, exact mass, or molecular weight. The option parameter specifies the search type. Only applicable to compound and drug databases.
